description: pkix-ac/src/lib.rs: validate_attribute_cert always returns Err(Error::ParseError). ParseError means the DER structure of the attribute cert is malformed. A caller who passes a valid, well-formed attribute cert will receive ParseError, which is factually wrong. The unimplemented stub should return a dedicated error or panic with 'not implemented'.
title: validate_attribute_cert returns ParseError for unimplemented function
